name: 初中英语（七年级—八年级上）

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—Where did you go on vacation?
—I ______ to the beach.
items.tip: 问过去的事用一般过去时，go 的过去式是 went。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—Did you buy anything special?
—No, I ______.
items.tip: Did ...? 的否定回答用 No, I didn't.

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—How often do you exercise?
—______ a week.
items.tip: How often 问频率，twice a week 一周两次。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: 下列频度副词中，频率最高的是？
items.tip: always > usually > often > sometimes > hardly ever > never。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “hardly ever” 的意思是？
items.tip: hardly ever = almost never。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Tom is ______ than his brother.
items.tip: than 表示比较，用比较级。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: This is the ______ movie theater in town.
items.tip: the + 最高级，good → better → best。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: My sister is ______ than me.
items.tip: 多音节形容词在前面加 more 构成比较级。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Which is the ______ of the three shirts?
items.tip: 三者或以上比较用最高级。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Lucy is as tall ______ her mother.
items.tip: as + 形容词原级 + as：和……一样。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: I'm going to ______ an engineer when I grow up.
items.tip: be going to + 动词原形。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: There ______ more trees in the city in the future.
items.tip: There will be ... 表示将来会有。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—Will people use money in 100 years?
—______
items.tip: Will ...? 用 will 回答，people 用 they 代替。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: How ______ milk do we need?
items.tip: milk 不可数，用 how much。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: How many ______ do we need?
items.tip: 以 o 结尾的 tomato、potato 复数加 -es。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—Can you come to my party?
—Sorry, I ______. I have to study for a test.
items.tip: 拒绝邀请：Sorry, I can't. + 理由。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.tip: if 条件句「主将从现」：从句用一般现在时。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: If you go to the party, you ______ have a great time.
items.tip: 主句用一般将来时。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: I'm interested ______ music.
items.tip: be interested in 对……感兴趣。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Thanks ______ inviting me to your party.
items.tip: thanks for doing sth. 因……而感谢。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: I enjoy ______ books in my free time.
items.tip: enjoy doing sth. 喜欢做某事。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: We decided ______ to the Great Wall.
items.tip: decide to do sth. 决定做某事。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Let's ______ shopping this weekend.
items.tip: Let's + 动词原形。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: I don't like this movie, and she doesn't like it, ______.
items.tip: 否定句中「也」用 either；肯定句用 too。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: There is only ______ water in the bottle.
items.tip: water 不可数，用 a little；a few 修饰可数名词。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “buy” 的过去式是？
items.tip: buy → bought；bring → brought。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “feel” 的过去式是？
items.tip: feel → felt；fall → fell。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: How do you make a banana milk shake? First, ______ three bananas.
items.tip: peel 剥皮；先把香蕉去皮。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “turn on” 的意思是？
items.tip: turn on 打开；turn off 关掉。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “take care of” 的意思是？
items.tip: take care of = look after 照顾。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: I can't go to the movies. I have to ______ my little sister.
items.tip: look after 照顾；look for 寻找。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—Thank you very much.
—______
items.tip: 回应感谢：You're welcome. / Not at all.

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Look! The children ______ soccer on the playground.
items.tip: Look! 提示正在进行，用现在进行时。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: Don't ______ in the classroom.
items.tip: 否定祈使句：Don't + 动词原形。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: This is ______ orange. ______ orange is on the table.
items.tip: orange 以元音音素开头用 an；特指用 the。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
—What time do you usually get up?
—______
items.tip: What time 问具体时刻。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: My birthday is ______ October.
items.tip: 在月份前用 in；在具体某一天前用 on。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “sheep” 的复数形式是？
items.tip: sheep、deer、fish（表示条数时）单复数同形。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “children” 是 “child” 的复数形式。
items.tip: child → children（不规则变化）。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: “good” 的比较级是 “gooder”。
items.tip: good/well → better → best。

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
Read: Lisa went to Hainan last summer. The weather was hot and sunny. She went swimming every day.
How was the weather in Hainan?
items.tip: 原文：The weather was hot and sunny.

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
Read: Lisa went to Hainan last summer. The weather was hot and sunny. She went swimming every day.
What did Lisa do every day?
items.tip: 原文：She went swimming every day.

items.subject: 英语
items.q:
Read: Tom is going to be a doctor. He is going to study medicine at university because he wants to help sick people.
Why does Tom want to be a doctor?
a: Because he wants to help sick people.
Because his father is a doctor.
items.tip: 原文 because he wants to help sick people。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (visit) her grandparents last weekend.
items.tip: last weekend 用一般过去时。

items.subject: 英语
items.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He is the ______ (funny) boy in our class.
items.tip: 辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -est。
